name: On the Dark Side
artist: John Cafferty and the Beaver Brown Band

artist_ref.name: John Cafferty & The Beaver Brown Band

podcast.body: Originally a 1983 single from the flop movie soundtrack *Eddie and the Cruisers*, this song, which sounded "an awful lot like Springsteen and the East Street band," was revived by radio stations and belatedly became a top ten hit in the fall of 1984 due to Bruce Springsteen's imperial phase. "John Cafferty and the Beaver Brown bands on the dark side became a top ten hit belatedly in the fall of 1984."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: Material Girl in an Imperial World Edition Part 1

podcast.title: Movie and Cable TV Revival
podcast.body: Originally released in the fall of 1983 on the "Eddie and the Cruisers" soundtrack and credited to "Eddie and the Cruisers," this single peaked at number 64 on the Hot 100 before quickly disappearing. In 1984, after the movie became a word-of-mouth hit on HBO and coincided with the resurgence of bar band rock, "On the Dark Side" was reissued, this time credited to John Cafferty and the Beaver Brown Band. It re-entered the Hot 100 and soared to number 7 by October. "In the late summer of 84, on the dark side was reissued, this time credited to John Cafferty and the Beaver Brown Band. And it blew up, reentering the hot 100 and soaring to number 7 by October."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
